record.context_brief: Birational structure of moduli of sheaves
record.original_question: Let X be a complex projective smooth minimal surface with Kodaira dimension kappa(X)=1, so X is an elliptic surface, and let M=MH(v) be the coarse moduli scheme of rank-two H-stable sheaves on X with fixed Chern classes v=(2,c1,c2). How can one determine the birational structure of M, for example its Kodaira dimension kappa(M)?

evidence.quote: Problem 1.1. ([16, Question.1.1]) How is the birational structure of M , for example its Kodaira dimen- sion kappa(M )?

In this section, we consider the case where kappa(X) = 1 and X is a minimal surface. In this case, X is an elliptic surface, that is, there is a fibration morphism pi : X -> C to a curve C such that its general fibers are elliptic.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective minimal surface of Kodaira dimension $\kappa(X)=1$; equivalently, $X$ admits an elliptic fibration $\pi:X\to C$ onto a smooth curve $C$ whose general fibers are smooth elliptic curves. Fix an ample divisor $H$ on $X$ and a Mukai/Chern vector $v=(2,c_1,c_2)$ with $c_1\in\mathrm{NS}(X)$ and $c_2\in\mathbb{Z}$. Let $M=M_H(v)$ denote the coarse moduli scheme of rank-two $H$-stable torsion-free coherent sheaves on $X$ with Chern classes $(c_1,c_2)$.

Determine the birational structure of $M$. In particular, compute the Kodaira dimension $\kappa(M)$ of (a smooth projective model of) $M$, and describe its Iitaka fibration in moduli-theoretic terms, as a function of the discrete invariants $(X,H,c_1,c_2)$.
artifact.category_tag: Moduli of sheaves on elliptic surfaces
artifact.status_search_result: Significant partial results are known. For elliptic surfaces $X\to\mathbb{P}^1$ with $\kappa(X)=1$, under restrictions on $c_1|_{\text{generic fiber}}$ and on the number of multiple fibers, the moduli space has canonical singularities and Kodaira dimension $(1+\dim M)/2$, with an Iitaka fibration described moduli-theoretically (e.g., for $\chi(\mathcal O_X)=1$ with two multiple fibers, one of multiplicity 2, and $c_2$ large). The general case (arbitrary elliptic surface, arbitrary $c_1, c_2$) is not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: The Kodaira dimension and singularities of moduli of stable sheaves on some elliptic surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies κ(M) for rank-two stable sheaves on elliptic surfaces with κ(X)=1, obtaining κ(M)=(1+dim M)/2 under hypotheses and describing the Iitaka fibration.
status_evidence.claim: The Kodaira dimension of M is computed under hypotheses on Chern classes and multiple fibers.

status_evidence.title: Some notes on the moduli of stable sheaves on elliptic surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates birational/structural properties of moduli of stable sheaves on elliptic surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results on the birational structure of M exist in the literature.
